chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
“When the riding animal stumbles beneath the man and he says to it, ‘May you perish,’ it says: ‘Perished is the one among us who is most disobedient to the Lord.’”

key_terms.أَعْصَانَا: the one among us who disobeyed most
key_terms.تَعَسْتِ: may you perish; an expression of cursing

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about cursing an animal when it stumbles?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches restraint in speech and condemns cursing an animal for a stumble. It redirects blame away from the creature and toward human disobedience to Allah, encouraging ethical conduct toward animals and moral self-reflection.
